propositions: Data Center transport submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to silently reject status changes since status is not an editable field
Cloud transport (acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue, but Data Center transport does not perform this routing, creating parity gap
outbound status 'In Progress' must resolve to the appropriate transition (e.g. 'Start Progress') and dispatch the transition, not submit the status name as a field edit
JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue must pop status from kwargs, resolve it via route_status_to_transition, and keep other allowlisted fields in the same field-edit call
illegal transitions from the current workflow state must remain non-fatal and observable in bridge alerts rather than silent failures
the test cell test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status] fails on Data Center with 'outbound status did not reach DC: fields.status.name is To Do' because status never transitions
